posts.text: Hi, Has anyone ever interacted with the management in the past or has any informed view on them? Had a query pertaining to the CEO designate. During media interactions at conferences like Autimechanika, Mr. Nitin Kumar Sontaki is interviewed as CEO though he doesn’t appear anywhere as CEO or designated as KMP / SMP in the annual report disclosures. What may be the reason behind the same? I thought Company’s Law and SEBI makes this mandatory that CEO has to be a KMP.
